headline: Vietnam's Eight-Month Import-Export Hits Record, Trade Deficit of USD 20.46 Billion
summary: Vietnam's goods trade reached $770.14 billion in the first eight months of 2026, up 28.7% year on year, a record for the period. Exports rose 22.4% and imports 35.3%, leaving a $20.46 billion deficit.
why: Vietnam is a major export manufacturing hub for electronics and textiles. Its trade data signals demand for global supply chains and regional currency pressure.
